items.title: Register now for our upcoming webinar on oral health and healthy ageing
items.summary: The CE accredited webinar will take place on 22 January at 3PM CET on the FDI Oral Health Campus. Don’t miss this opportunity to learn about system-based approaches to improving oral health in long-term care settings. Image FDI is pleased to announce an upcoming webinar on the FDI Oral Health Campus , titled "Oral Health and Healthy Ageing: Prevention and Integration in Long-Term Care Systems".
